question: By whose grace does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have become known or to know through grace.
That knowledge is of the determination of the Kaula teaching.
The means is the grace of the addressed lord.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact sense of jñāta here is not fully determined by these tokens alone.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
